rules.name: Modelo autorizado
rules.definition: blockName in catalogItems and insertionEnabled=true

rules.name: Atributos obligatorios
rules.definition: Every attribute marked requiredOnInsertion exists, has nonblank value and correct primitive type.

rules.name: Valor y dominio de atributos
rules.definition: fixedValue, allowedValues, pattern, min and max are satisfied; unknown proposed attributes rejected.

rules.name: Código de instancia único
rules.definition: Normalized INSTANCE_CODE is unique among existing and proposed instances; case-insensitive.

rules.name: Cantidad de inserciones
rules.definition: 1 <= proposed count <= 6.

rules.name: Complemento con padre válido
rules.definition: PARENT_CODE resolves one existing or proposed Machine; never to Rack or Complement.

rules.name: Compatibilidad complemento-máquina
rules.definition: Machine MODEL in complement.allowedParentModels.

rules.name: Máximo complemento por máquina
rules.definition: At most one BEACON_A and one BUTTON_STATION_A per parent MACHINE by PARENT_CODE.

rules.name: Unidades conocidas
rules.definition: INSUNITS=4 (millimeters) for experimental drawings; no guess when unitless/unknown.

rules.name: Dentro del área de trabajo
rules.definition: Every footprint remains inside ZONE_ALLOWED and, when the request targets a named zone, also entirely inside that named target zone; borders inclusive.

rules.name: Fuera de zonas prohibidas
rules.definition: Footprints must not overlap any forbidden-zone polygon; boundary touching counts as allowed.

rules.name: No intersección de entidades
rules.definition: No interior overlap between occupied footprints (including proposed versus proposed).

rules.name: Separación Rack-Rack
rules.definition: Minimum Euclidean footprint distance Rack-Rack >= 500 mm.

rules.name: Separación Rack-Machine
rules.definition: Minimum Euclidean footprint distance Rack-Machine >= 1000 mm.

rules.name: Separación Machine-Machine
rules.definition: Minimum Euclidean footprint distance Machine-Machine >= 1500 mm.

rules.name: Distancia Beacon a su padre
rules.definition: Perimeter gap between beacon footprint and parent machine footprint is [100,1200] mm.

rules.name: Distancia Botonera a su padre
rules.definition: Perimeter gap between button-station footprint and parent machine footprint is [500,2000] mm.

rules.name: Separación complemento ajeno
rules.definition: Complement cannot overlap any other entity, including a different host; no 1m rack-machine rule is transferred to accessory.

rules.name: Referencias y ambigüedad
rules.definition: Spatial direction/frame, distance or selected reference must be specified for relation-dependent placement.

rules.name: Restricciones duras vs. preferencias
rules.definition: Do not alter hard quantity, parent, attribute identity or exclusion zone without explicit user authorization.

rules.name: Revalidación del documento
rules.definition: Invalidate proposals if drawing changed; recalculate and revalidate under document lock immediately before AutoCAD transaction.

rules.name: Confirmación y atomicidad
rules.definition: No write until explicit confirmation; all intended inserts commit in one transaction or rollback.
